Package neqsim.process.processmodel

Class RunBudget

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.RunBudget
public final class RunBudget extends Object
Opt-in wall-clock, cancellation and stagnation budget shared by a ProcessSystem run (and by all areas of a ProcessModel run).

The budget is cooperative: it is checked between unit operations and between recycle, adjuster and outer-model iterations. A single unit operation that never returns cannot be interrupted. All budget features are off by default (maximum run time 0, stall window 0), in which case a run behaves exactly as before.

The owner of the outermost run calls enter() and exit(); nested runs (a model run that runs its areas, or ProcessSystem.runUntilConverged(int) that runs the process several times) share one clock and one trip state. requestStop() and checkStop(String) are thread-safe.

    • setMaxRunTimeSeconds

      public void setMaxRunTimeSeconds(double seconds)
      Sets the wall-clock budget of one run.
      Parameters:
      seconds - maximum run time in seconds; zero or negative disables the time budget

    • getMaxRunTimeSeconds

      public double getMaxRunTimeSeconds()
      Gets the wall-clock budget.
      Returns:
      maximum run time in seconds, zero if disabled

    • setStallDetection

      public void setStallDetection(int window, double minRelativeImprovement)
      Enables stagnation detection: a run is stopped with RunBudget.Outcome.STALLED when the residual did not improve by the minimum fraction for the given number of consecutive iterations.
      Parameters:
      window - number of consecutive iterations without improvement; zero or negative disables detection
      minRelativeImprovement - minimum relative improvement of the best residual that counts as progress (for example 1.0e-3)

    • getStallWindow

      public int getStallWindow()
      Gets the stall window.
      Returns:
      number of iterations without improvement that trip the budget, zero if disabled

      Returns:
      relative improvement
